svg.title: The rules on an A100
svg.desc: On the A100 beside 24 agent sessions: in panel a, at the RTX 5060 Ti's 512-token steps, tuned vLLM's V2V p95 and the configuration to deploy's in each of five rounds against the card's SLO of 1.67 s (4.16 and 1.66 s, 4.78 and 1.66 s, 4.99 and 1.61 s, 5.17 and 1.63 s, 5.71 and 1.61 s); in panel b, at each step cap, each one's V2V p95 and its agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, the median of its runs with their range (at 512-token steps tuned vLLM 4.99 s at 8,633 tokens/s, the configuration to deploy 1.63 s at 8,651 tokens/s, medians of 5 runs each; at 2,048-token steps tuned vLLM 3.66 s at 14,536 tokens/s, the configuration to deploy 1.83 s at 14,635 tokens/s, medians of 2 runs each; from 512- to 2,048-token steps the configuration to deploy's p95 changes by +0.19 s and its agents' tokens a second by +69%).
svg.text: (b) Both step caps: the voice tail and the agents' throughput
Tokens/s over the calls' first 240 s
